workflows.macos-beta:
name: macOS beta

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: Beta version (for example 0.1.0-beta.1)
        required: true
        default: 0.1.0-beta.28
  push:
    tags: ["desktop-v*"]

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: macos-desktop-release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-14
    timeout-minutes: 180
    env:
      HAS_APPLE_CERTIFICATE: ${{ secrets.APPLE_CERTIFICATE_P12 != '' }}
      HAS_APPLE_NOTARY_KEY: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_P8 != '' }}
      HAS_SPARKLE_KEYS: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_PUBLIC_KEY != '' && secrets.SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY != '' }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out Jcode Desktop
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          path: jcode-desktop
      - name: Check out Jcode runtime
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          repository: 1jehuang/jcode
          ref: 56fb1f163aff19f5baeeda642c79f8499e597d0f # Session recovery, native state, and current SDK APIs
          path: jcode
          submodules: recursive
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@4360b52568e2003a75bf9bc1d59f33a8e3fc893c # stable
        with:
          targets: aarch64-apple-darwin,x86_64-apple-darwin
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@49a0bdc70d2e1b713ca9e2869b211fcce03d3c1c # v2
        with:
          workspaces: |
            jcode-desktop
            jcode
      - name: Validate release credentials
        env:
          CERTIFICATE_P12: ${{ secrets.APPLE_CERTIFICATE_P12 }}
          CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
          SIGNING_IDENTITY: ${{ secrets.APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY }}
          API_KEY_P8: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_P8 }}
          API_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_ID }}
          API_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_ISSUER_ID }}
          SPARKLE_PUBLIC_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_PUBLIC_KEY }}
          SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: |
          signing=0
          notarization=0
          updates=0
          [[ -n "$CERTIFICATE_P12" && -n "$CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD" && -n "$SIGNING_IDENTITY" ]] && signing=1
          [[ -n "$API_KEY_P8" && -n "$API_KEY_ID" && -n "$API_ISSUER_ID" ]] && notarization=1
          [[ -n "$SPARKLE_PUBLIC_KEY" && -n "$SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY" ]] && updates=1

          if [[ $signing -eq 0 && -n "$CERTIFICATE_P12$CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD$SIGNING_IDENTITY" ]]; then
            echo "Signing credentials must be configured as a complete set." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ $notarization -eq 0 && -n "$API_KEY_P8$API_KEY_ID$API_ISSUER_ID" ]]; then
            echo "Notarization credentials must be configured as a complete set." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ $notarization -eq 1 && $signing -eq 0 ]]; then
            echo "Notarization requires Developer ID signing credentials." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == refs/tags/desktop-v* ]] && \
             [[ $signing -eq 0 || $notarization -eq 0 ]]; then
            echo "Tagged macOS releases require Developer ID signing and notarization credentials." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == refs/tags/desktop-v* && $updates -eq 0 ]]; then
            echo "Tagged macOS releases require Sparkle public and private keys." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ $updates -eq 0 && -n "$SPARKLE_PUBLIC_KEY$SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY" ]]; then
            echo "Sparkle public and private keys must be configured together." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Import Developer ID certificate
        if: env.HAS_APPLE_CERTIFICATE == 'true'
        env:
          CERTIFICATE_P12: ${{ secrets.APPLE_CERTIFICATE_P12 }}
          CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          KEYCHAIN="$RUNNER_TEMP/jcode-signing.keychain-db"
          security create-keychain -p runner "$KEYCHAIN"
          security set-keychain-settings -lut 21600 "$KEYCHAIN"
          security unlock-keychain -p runner "$KEYCHAIN"
          echo "$CERTIFICATE_P12" | base64 --decode > "$RUNNER_TEMP/certificate.p12"
          security import "$RUNNER_TEMP/certificate.p12" -P "$CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD" -A -t cert -f pkcs12 -k "$KEYCHAIN"
          security list-keychain -d user -s "$KEYCHAIN"
          security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple: -s -k runner "$KEYCHAIN"
      - name: Configure notarization
        if: env.HAS_APPLE_NOTARY_KEY == 'true'
        env:
          APPLE_API_KEY_P8: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_P8 }}
          APPLE_API_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_ID }}
          APPLE_API_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_ISSUER_ID }}
        run: |
          echo "$APPLE_API_KEY_P8" | base64 --decode > "$RUNNER_TEMP/AuthKey.p8"
          xcrun notarytool store-credentials jcode-notary \
            --key "$RUNNER_TEMP/AuthKey.p8" --key-id "$APPLE_API_KEY_ID" \
            --issuer "$APPLE_API_ISSUER_ID"
      - name: Build universal app, DMG, and ZIP
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version || github.ref_name }}
          JCODE_REPO: ${{ github.workspace }}/jcode
          APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY: ${{ secrets.APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY || '-' }}
          APPLE_NOTARY_PROFILE: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_P8 != '' && 'jcode-notary' || '' }}
          SPARKLE_PUBLIC_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_PUBLIC_KEY }}
          REQUIRE_SECURE_UPDATES: ${{ env.HAS_SPARKLE_KEYS == 'true' && '1' || '0' }}
        run: jcode-desktop/scripts/package-macos.sh
      - name: Verify app bundle and DMG install path
        env:
          EXPECT_NOTARIZED: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_P8 != '' && '1' || '0' }}
          FIRST_LAUNCH_CHECK: "1"
        run: jcode-desktop/scripts/verify-macos-package.sh
      - name: Sign automatic update and generate appcast
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/desktop-v') && env.HAS_SPARKLE_KEYS == 'true'
        env:
          SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: |
          VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#desktop-v}"
          UPDATES="$RUNNER_TEMP/jcode-updates"
          ARCHIVE="Jcode-${VERSION}-macOS-universal.zip"
          mkdir -p "$UPDATES"
          cp jcode-desktop/dist/macos/Jcode-macOS-universal.zip "$UPDATES/$ARCHIVE"
          printf '%s\n' "$SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY" | \
            jcode-desktop/dist/macos/sparkle/bin/generate_appcast \
              --ed-key-file - \
              --download-url-prefix "https://jcode.sh/desktop/releases/$GITHUB_REF_NAME/" \
              "$UPDATES"
          test -s "$UPDATES/appcast.xml"
          grep -q 'sparkle:edSignature=' "$UPDATES/appcast.xml"
          cp "$UPDATES/appcast.xml" jcode-desktop/dist/macos/appcast.xml
          cp "$UPDATES/$ARCHIVE" jcode-desktop/dist/macos/
          (
            cd jcode-desktop/dist/macos
            shasum -a 256 "$ARCHIVE" Jcode-macOS-universal.dmg > SHA256SUMS
          )
      - name: Upload workflow artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: Jcode-macOS-beta
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            jcode-desktop/dist/macos/Jcode-macOS-universal.dmg
            jcode-desktop/dist/macos/Jcode-macOS-universal.zip
            jcode-desktop/dist/macos/Jcode-*-macOS-universal.zip
            jcode-desktop/dist/macos/appcast.xml
            jcode-desktop/dist/macos/SHA256SUMS
      - name: Publish tagged beta release
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/desktop-v')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#desktop-v}"
          VERSIONED_ZIP="jcode-desktop/dist/macos/Jcode-${VERSION}-macOS-universal.zip"
          if [[ ! -f "$VERSIONED_ZIP" ]]; then
            cp jcode-desktop/dist/macos/Jcode-macOS-universal.zip "$VERSIONED_ZIP"
          fi
          (
            cd jcode-desktop/dist/macos
            shasum -a 256 "$(basename "$VERSIONED_ZIP")" Jcode-macOS-universal.dmg > SHA256SUMS
          )
          if ! gh release view "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --title "Jcode Desktop ${GITHUB_REF_NAME#desktop-v}" --prerelease \
              --notes "macOS beta for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Download the DMG, drag Jcode to Applications, and open it. The Jcode runtime is included."
          fi
          gh release upload "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber \
            jcode-desktop/dist/macos/Jcode-macOS-universal.dmg \
            "$VERSIONED_ZIP" \
            jcode-desktop/dist/macos/SHA256SUMS \
            jcode-desktop/dist/macos/appcast.xml
          if [[ -f jcode-desktop/dist/macos/appcast.xml ]] && ! gh release view desktop-updates --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create desktop-updates --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --target "$GITHUB_SHA" --prerelease --title "Jcode Desktop update feed" \
              --notes "Machine-readable Sparkle update feed. Download the latest desktop release instead."
          fi
          if [[ -f jcode-desktop/dist/macos/appcast.xml ]]; then
            gh release upload desktop-updates --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber \
              jcode-desktop/dist/macos/appcast.xml
          fi
workflows.cross-platform-release:
name: Linux and Windows desktop release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: Package version used for validation artifacts
        required: true
        default: 0.1.0-beta.28
  push:
    tags: ["desktop-v*"]

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: desktop-release-${{ github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            platform: linux
          - os: windows-2025
            platform: windows
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    # Cold Windows builds plus the multi-GB post-job cache save exceeded 120m
    # in beta27 after packaging, smoke tests, and artifact upload had passed.
    timeout-minutes: 180
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          path: jcode-desktop
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          repository: 1jehuang/jcode
          ref: 56fb1f163aff19f5baeeda642c79f8499e597d0f # Session recovery, native state, and current SDK APIs
          path: jcode
          submodules: recursive
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@4360b52568e2003a75bf9bc1d59f33a8e3fc893c # stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@49a0bdc70d2e1b713ca9e2869b211fcce03d3c1c # v2
        with:
          workspaces: |
            jcode-desktop
            jcode
          cache-on-failure: true
      - name: Install Linux build dependencies
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libasound2-dev libfontconfig-dev libxkbcommon-dev libxkbcommon-x11-dev \
            libwayland-dev libx11-xcb-dev libxcb1-dev libxcb-render0-dev \
            libxcb-shape0-dev libxcb-xfixes0-dev libgl1-mesa-dri \
            mesa-vulkan-drivers openbox wayland-utils weston x11-utils xvfb
      - name: Build and package Linux
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux'
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version || github.ref_name }}
          JCODE_REPO: ${{ github.workspace }}/jcode
        run: jcode-desktop/scripts/package-linux.sh
      - name: Verify Linux package
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux'
        run: |
          python3 jcode-desktop/scripts/verify-release-package.py jcode-desktop/dist/linux/*.tar.gz
          dpkg-deb --info jcode-desktop/dist/linux/*.deb
          dpkg-deb --contents jcode-desktop/dist/linux/*.deb | grep -E 'jcode-desktop|jcode-harness-api-bridge|jcode.desktop|jcode.png'
          (cd jcode-desktop/dist/linux && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS-linux)
      # Keep the hour-long Linux build recoverable if smoke infrastructure
      # fails. The publish job remains gated on this entire matrix job.
      - name: Preserve packaged Linux artifacts before smoke
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: desktop-linux-x86_64
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            jcode-desktop/dist/linux/Jcode-*.tar.gz
            jcode-desktop/dist/linux/Jcode-*.deb
            jcode-desktop/dist/linux/SHA256SUMS-linux
      - name: Smoke-test Linux package on X11
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          app=$(find jcode-desktop/dist/linux -type f -name jcode-desktop | head -1)
          cli=$(dirname "$app")/jcode
          "$cli" --version
          smoke="$RUNNER_TEMP/jcode-linux-smoke/x11"
          runtime="$smoke/runtime"
          home="$smoke/home"
          mkdir -p "$runtime" "$home"
          chmod 700 "$runtime"
          timeout 25s xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x800x24' bash -c '
            set -euo pipefail
            app=$1; runtime=$2; home=$3; smoke=$4
            openbox >"$smoke/openbox.log" 2>&1 &
            openbox_pid=$!
            trap '\''kill "$openbox_pid" 2>/dev/null || true'\'' EXIT
            for _ in {1..50}; do
              xprop -root _NET_SUPPORTING_WM_CHECK >/dev/null 2>&1 && break
              sleep 0.1
            done
            xprop -root _NET_SUPPORTING_WM_CHECK >/dev/null
            env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$runtime" HOME="$home" \
              LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 WGPU_BACKEND=vulkan \
              "$app" >"$smoke/app.log" 2>&1 &
            pid=$!
            sleep 8
            if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
              wait "$pid" || status=$?
              echo "X11 app exited before smoke completed (status ${status:-0})" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            kill "$pid"
            wait "$pid" || true
          ' bash "$app" "$runtime" "$home" "$smoke"
      - name: Smoke-test Linux package on native Wayland
        if: matrix.platform == 'linux'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          app=$(find jcode-desktop/dist/linux -type f -name jcode-desktop | head -1)
          smoke="$RUNNER_TEMP/jcode-linux-smoke/wayland"
          runtime="$smoke/runtime"
          home="$smoke/home"
          mkdir -p "$runtime" "$home"
          chmod 700 "$runtime"
          # Weston's headless backend has no wl_seat, which GPUI requires.
          # Nest Weston in Xvfb to expose a virtual seat, then remove DISPLAY
          # from the app so the tested client path is still native Wayland.
          timeout 30s xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x800x24' bash -c '
            set -euo pipefail
            app=$1; runtime=$2; home=$3; smoke=$4
            openbox >"$smoke/openbox.log" 2>&1 &
            openbox_pid=$!
            XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$runtime" LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 \
              weston --backend=x11-backend.so --use-pixman \
                --socket=jcode-ci-wayland --idle-time=0 >"$smoke/weston.log" 2>&1 &
            weston_pid=$!
            trap '\''kill "$weston_pid" "$openbox_pid" 2>/dev/null || true'\'' EXIT
            ready=0
            for _ in {1..100}; do
              if [[ -S "$runtime/jcode-ci-wayland" ]] && \
                 XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$runtime" WAYLAND_DISPLAY=jcode-ci-wayland \
                   timeout 2s wayland-info >"$smoke/registry.log" 2>&1 && \
                 grep -q wl_seat "$smoke/registry.log"; then
                ready=1
                break
              fi
              kill -0 "$weston_pid" 2>/dev/null || break
              sleep 0.1
            done
            [[ "$ready" == 1 ]]
            env -u DISPLAY XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$runtime" HOME="$home" \
              WAYLAND_DISPLAY=jcode-ci-wayland LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 \
              WGPU_BACKEND=vulkan "$app" >"$smoke/app.log" 2>&1 &
            pid=$!
            sleep 8
            if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
              wait "$pid" || status=$?
              echo "Wayland app exited before smoke completed (status ${status:-0})" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            kill "$pid"
            wait "$pid" || true
          ' bash "$app" "$runtime" "$home" "$smoke"
      - name: Print Linux smoke diagnostics
        if: always() && matrix.platform == 'linux'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          shopt -s nullglob globstar
          for file in "$RUNNER_TEMP"/jcode-linux-smoke/**/*.log; do
            echo "===== $file ====="
            cat "$file"
          done
          for file in "$RUNNER_TEMP"/jcode-linux-smoke/*/home/.local/state/jcode-desktop/*.log; do
            echo "===== $file ====="
            cat "$file"
          done
      - name: Upload Linux smoke diagnostics
        if: always() && matrix.platform == 'linux'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          # The publish job downloads desktop-* as release assets.
          name: linux-smoke-diagnostics
          if-no-files-found: warn
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 7
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/jcode-linux-smoke
      - name: Build and package Windows
        if: matrix.platform == 'windows'
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version || github.ref_name }}
          JCODE_REPO: ${{ github.workspace }}/jcode
        run: ./jcode-desktop/scripts/package-windows.ps1
      - name: Verify Windows package
        if: matrix.platform == 'windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          python jcode-desktop/scripts/verify-release-package.py (Get-ChildItem jcode-desktop/dist/windows/*.zip).FullName
          $stage = Get-ChildItem jcode-desktop/dist/windows -Directory -Filter 'Jcode-*-windows-x86_64' | Select-Object -First 1
          & "$($stage.FullName)/jcode.exe" --version
          if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Bundled Jcode CLI did not start' }
      - name: Smoke-test Windows package
        if: matrix.platform == 'windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $stage = Get-ChildItem jcode-desktop/dist/windows -Directory -Filter 'Jcode-*-windows-x86_64' | Select-Object -First 1
          $log = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'jcode-desktop-windows.log'
          $process = Start-Process -FilePath "$($stage.FullName)/jcode-desktop.exe" -RedirectStandardOutput $log -RedirectStandardError "$log.err" -PassThru
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 8
          if ($process.HasExited) {
            Get-Content $log, "$log.err" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            throw "Jcode Desktop exited during launch with code $($process.ExitCode)"
          }
          Stop-Process -Id $process.Id
          $process.WaitForExit()
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        if: matrix.platform == 'windows'
        with:
          name: desktop-${{ matrix.platform }}-x86_64
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            jcode-desktop/dist/${{ matrix.platform }}/Jcode-*.tar.gz
            jcode-desktop/dist/${{ matrix.platform }}/Jcode-*.deb
            jcode-desktop/dist/${{ matrix.platform }}/Jcode-*.zip
            jcode-desktop/dist/${{ matrix.platform }}/SHA256SUMS-*

  publish:
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/desktop-v')
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 190
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          pattern: desktop-*
          path: artifacts
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Wait for secure macOS workflow and upload to its prerelease
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          for attempt in {1..90}; do
            if gh release view "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json isPrerelease --jq '.isPrerelease' | grep -qx true; then
              mapfile -d '' files < <(find artifacts -type f -print0)
              test "${#files[@]}" -gt 0
              gh release upload "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber "${files[@]}"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Waiting for notarized macOS workflow to create prerelease ($attempt/90)..."
            sleep 120
          done
          echo "macOS secure workflow did not create the prerelease" >&2
          exit 1
